topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Finding this, a crumpled edge of paper peeking from a drawer, is like stumbling upon hidden sun. Each item, a whisper of the unknown, now shared. It’s a map, not just anywhere, but everywhere they dream of. Mountains, quiet and tall, await our steps. The sea, vast and deep, calls us to its embrace. I trace each line, feeling a flutter, a pull. The world feels a little brighter, full of things just for us to discover, together. This paper, fragile yet strong, binds us to promises of shared breaths and steps.
